title: Agentflow execution plan frontmatter
description: Contract for the YAML frontmatter of a Markdown execution plan at docs/features/<批次>/plan/<plan_id>.md — a plan lives inside its feature batch, not in a top-level plans/ root (that root was dissolved). Hybrid form: the frontmatter carries the machine-checked envelope; the body carries the human narrative (progress overview, task table with per-task status and evidence write-back, contracts, gates, verification commands). Body assertions enforced by the validator: task IDs unique, dependency references resolve and are acyclic, task statuses are a fixed enum, blocking unresolved decisions are closed before status approved, required body sections exist.

status.description: draft = being written; proposed = awaiting approval; approved = execution may be assigned (a plan is an execution contract, not an authorization to change code); superseded = replaced by a newer plan_version.

superseded_by.description: plan_id of the replacing plan, required when status is superseded.

decision_deps.description: Optional cross-batch decision dependencies, one token per element (DEC-YYYY-NNN#rN or DEC-YYYY-NNN#invariant=原文); enforced by tools/lab/decisions.py check.
